verification.assembly: The existing typed assembler computes canonical root and object CIDs, and FinalizePack publishes manifest.json only after exact-set object verification.
verification.reader: The reader requires canonical closed manifest structure, fixed v1 schema and role inventories, explicit required fields, fixed retention/media/schema mappings, and exact inline-judgment binding.
verification.filesystem: Darwin and Linux verification uses bounded descriptor-relative no-follow, nonblocking reads; exact 0500/0400 modes; single-link regular files; same-filesystem directories; exact root/object sets; and a final identity, mode, size, mtime, and ctime recheck.
verification.cli: openbox project verify PACK reports only the verified pack digest and role count from immutable in-memory bytes; it performs no project execution, network access, sandbox launch, or control-plane action.

bounds.directory_enumeration: root at most 2, objects at most 1, and sha256 entries at most the unique referenced CID count

limits: Verification is a point-in-time statement over immutable returned bytes; a same-UID actor can mutate the on-disk directory after success.
